# Shiro Turbo (`shiro_turbo`) — spec sheet

## Design note

The drift scene's favourite: balanced, light, and with a 1.5-way LSD that locks on and off throttle so it holds a slide. Not brutally fast, but the most communicative chassis in the roster and the easiest to throw sideways on purpose.

## How this car breaks

Light coupe shell with long doors and thin sills: side impacts reach the cabin quickly. The front clip is cheap to replace (bumper, hood and fenders bolt on and come off easily). The rear subframe sits right under the boot, so rear-enders bend the axle geometry early.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for early-2000s 2.0 T FR coupes
- owner dyno averages for 2.0 L turbo I4s in that segment
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, opposed-piston caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 500 | 0.80 | 400 |
| pitch | 2364 | 0.88 | 2080 |
| yaw | 2499 | 0.88 | 2200 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.84·W·H = 1.83 m²; Cd = 0.29 → **CdA = 0.531 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.06 / +0.08 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

2.0 L DOHC I4, single ball-bearing turbo, intercooled. Class-typical early-2000s 2.0 T coupe (~92 kW/L); late, flat torque from a larger turbo, per owner dyno averages.

| rpm | N·m | kW |
|---|---|---|
| 1000 | 140 | 14.7 |
| 1500 | 170 | 26.7 |
| 2000 | 205 | 42.9 |
| 2500 | 240 | 62.8 |
| 3000 | 258 | 81.1 |
| 3500 | 266 | 97.5 |
| 4000 | 272 | 113.9 |
| 4500 | 275 | 129.6 |
| 5000 | 276 | 144.5 |
| 5500 | 272 | 156.7 |
| 6000 | 268 | 168.4 |
| 6500 | 268 | 182.4 |
| 7000 | 240 | 175.9 |
| 7500 | 205 | 161.0 |

Peak **182 kW @ 6500 rpm**, **276 N·m @ 5000 rpm**. Idle 850 / redline 7200 / limiter 7500 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.13 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 33 N·m. Power-to-weight 138 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed manual, clutch-type 1.5-way rear LSD. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 60 N·m, power ramp 0.45, coast ramp 0.30. Clutch capacity 1.45 × peak torque = 400 N·m. Shift time 0.22 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.32 | 13.55 | 62 |
| 2 | 1.90 | 7.75 | 108 |
| 3 | 1.31 | 5.34 | 156 |
| 4 | 1.00 | 4.08 | 205 |
| 5 | 0.76 | 3.10 | 269 |
| 6 | 0.66 | 2.69 | 310 |

Final drive 4.08, reverse 3.38. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.308 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.32 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 344 kg | 1.85 Hz | 46500 N/m | 2560 N·s/m | 3840 N·s/m | 0.13 m |
| Rear | 276 kg | 1.95 Hz | 41500 N/m | 2170 N·s/m | 3260 N·s/m | 0.14 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.0°/g with 60% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.362 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 134799 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 50960 F / 44786 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **13700 F / 4200 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.0°/g, front share 60%. Bump stops 170000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -1.0° F / -1.3° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.20° R (+ = in), caster 6.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 296 mm disc, pistons per side 42 mm + 42 mm → A = 27.7 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 123 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·27.7 cm²·0.123 m = **2863 N·m**
- Rear: 297 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm → A = 11.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 124 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·11.3 cm²·0.123 m = **1121 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1443 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.98×), rear needs 535 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.09×). `bias_front` = f + 0.9·h/L = 0.71 (ideal distribution at 0.9 g, clamped 0.55-0.78). Handbrake 1010 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 10.4 m → outer-front path radius 5.09 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.68 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.601 rad (34.4°)** (outer 29.7°, inner 40.6° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.50). Rack speed 1.6 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/shiro_turbo.json`)

120 nodes, 704 beams, 3 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-box-lattice --id shiro_turbo --width 1.695 --length 4.445 --height 1.285 --wheelbase 2.525 --mass 291.5 --clearance 0.13` (22% of vehicle mass).
- Shaped top layer to the `coupe` profile (hood/deck/bumper tops dropped to beltline, greenhouse narrowed to 86% width).
- Beams: pillars + roof rails → hss 4.5e-04 m² (34 beams).
- Beams: cabin cell → hss 4.5e-04 m² (88 beams).
- Beams: sills → hss 5.0e-04 m² (6 beams).
- Beams: crumple (outer) rail segments → hss 2.5e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: inner rail segments / firewall → hss 4.5e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: hood → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (16 beams).
- Beams: outer panels → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (284 beams).
- Components: radiator at row 8 ahead of the engine (fails first), longitudinal engine at row 7, gearbox in the tunnel, prop shaft to the rear axle, fuel tank ahead of the rear axle.
- Detachables: FrontBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, RearBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, Hood 5000 N·s / 15 kg.
- Node mass: engine-mount nodes ×2.5, renormalised to 291 kg total.
